protocol: Moi agent doc file nay truoc khi sua bat ky file nao. Them message moi vao cuoi mang 'messages'. Nhan file bang cach ghi vao 'locks' truoc khi sua, xoa lock khi xong. Khong sua tests/, tasks/, scripts/, file co san, skills/auto/ (chi curator duoc ghi). Sau tag freeze tuyet doi khong dong vao skills/.

agent-A.role: Dieu phoi chinh: curator, chay thi nghiem, freeze, report

agent-B.role: Chua khoi dong (ListAgents luc 2026-10-06 12:29 +07 khong thay session nao khac)
agent-B.status: khong tham gia (nguoi dung xac nhan agent-A lam mot minh)

state.verify_freeze: checked 6 runs of skill conditions: OK (exit 0)
state.skills_auto: code-change-completion, log-output-normalization (dong bang, KHONG DUOC SUA)
state.secrets_scan: khong co key/endpoint trong repo; .env chua tung commit

messages.text: Da doc README, RUBRIC, GUIDE, pseudocode. 4 file src/lab da cai dat xong, 29/29 test pass, khop pseudocode. So lieu REPORT muc 4-5 da doi chieu khop results/. Buoc tiep theo agent-A lam: danh gia skill (Phan 3.3), chay skills-auto learn (3.4), viet gia thuyet, freeze. Vui long KHONG sua cac file trong 'locks'. Neu muon giup: review doc lap REPORT.md sau khi agent-A gui handoff.

Da sua prompt curator (src/lab/curator.py), chay lai curator 1 lan, chay Phan 3.4, sao luu sang results/skills-auto-dev. REPORT muc 1, 2 (H1-H3), 6 da dien. Chuan bi commit 'hypotheses' va tag 'freeze'. SAU TAG: khong ai duoc dong vao skills/.

Hoan thanh Phan 0-5. Van de da ghi nhan, KHONG che giau: (1) skills-auto/logs-eval mat 5 check ky thuat (13/18 tech tren eval) vi tac tu chep tay errors.json thay vi viet script - da phan tich trong REPORT muc 8.3, coi la nhieu 1 lan chay, khong khang dinh do skill; (2) curator lan 2 khong sinh skill cho ho data; (3) prompt curator da sua giua 2 lan chay - ghi o muc 6 va 9. Viec de nghi agent-B: review doc lap REPORT.md doi chieu results/ (chi doc, gui nhan xet vao file nay). Tuyet doi khong sua skills/. Phan thuong (Phan 6) chua lam - can nguoi dung quyet dinh vi ton them token.

Nguoi dung xac nhan khong co agent khac. Huy handoff review cho agent-B; agent-A tu review: moi diem passed/total cua 21 run.json deu xuat hien dung trong REPORT.md, moi so token duoc trich deu khop results/. Bai lab hoan thanh Phan 0-5; Phan 6 (thuong) chua lam.
